questions.question: Which optical wavelength is predominantly absorbed by Deoxygenated Hemoglobin (Hb) compared to Oxygenated Hemoglobin (HbO₂)?

explanations.a: Correct. At 660 nm, Deoxyhemoglobin exhibits roughly 10x greater optical extinction than Oxyhemoglobin.
explanations.b: Incorrect. 940 nm is absorbed more strongly by Oxyhemoglobin.
explanations.c: Incorrect. 805 nm is the isosbestic point where extinction is equal.
explanations.d: Incorrect. 1310 nm is not used for dual-wavelength pulse oximetry.

questions.question: What is the primary role of a Transimpedance Amplifier (TIA) in a pulse oximeter analog front-end?

answers.a: To generate the 500 Hz LED drive clock
answers.b: To convert the photodiode current (I_PD) into a proportional voltage
answers.c: To calculate the modulation ratio R directly
answers.d: To display SpO₂ values on an OLED screen

explanations.a: Incorrect. Timing clocks are generated by a microcontroller or timer IC.
explanations.b: Correct. A TIA uses an op-amp with feedback resistor Rf to translate microampere photocurrent into Volts.
explanations.c: Incorrect. The ratio R is computed digitally in software/DSP.
explanations.d: Incorrect. The OLED screen is driven by the microcontroller.

questions.question: What does the AC component of a photoplethysmogram (PPG) signal physically represent?

answers.a: Light absorbed by venous blood and bone
answers.b: Pulsatile arterial blood volume changes with each cardiac cycle

explanations.a: Incorrect. Venous blood and bone constitute the non-pulsatile DC baseline.
explanations.b: Correct. The AC component corresponds to the pulsatile influx of arterial blood during ventricular systole.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Room lighting is an unwanted interference artifact.
